verdict.rationale: FFmpeg publishes a static, nightly-regenerated Doxygen API reference and ships source code examples in doc/examples. Neither is an interactive API explorer with runnable examples, so these are only adjacent documentation features. Probes found no OpenAPI or similar machine-readable interactive reference, and a community user reports that clear API (libav) documentation and examples are hard to find.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
